concept: API Gateway: throttling and response caching to protect the backend
tests: Knowing the API Gateway features that reduce backend load without changing Lambda code.
expected: Throttling (rate and burst limits) at the stage/method + response caching for repeated identical requests. Triggers: "cap the request rate", "repeated identical calls", "without changing the Lambda code".
why_not: WebSocket API is for bidirectional real-time and does not protect against spikes; disabling CloudWatch logging only hurts observability.
